create_sampler: create a Griffin model sampler with a Flax module, SentencePiece vocab, and JAX params
sample_completion: sample text completions from a Griffin model given input strings and generation steps
tokenize_input: tokenize an input string into JAX integer array with BOS token prepended
sample_from_logits: sample next tokens from model logits using argmax or categorical distribution
process_prompt: pre-process prompt tokens into a SamplingState with positions, cache, and buffers
